intent: Follow June’s last afternoon through sunset, woodland shadows and lantern light to the quiet threshold of the storm. Expert redesign: dusk sail transfers and gathering storm arcs.

sections.name: The last afternoon fields
sections.lesson: Follow the warm light towards the ridge. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
